newsitem.title: USA: Caldor gets extension to file plan.
newsitem.headline: Caldor gets extension to file plan.

text.p: Caldor Corp said Wednesday that the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of New York granted it an extension of the period under which it has the exclusive right to file a plan of reorganization with the court.

The company said the exclusivity period, which had been scheduled to expire on February 28, has now been extended through September 1, with the support of the company's Creditors', Bank and Equity Committees.
Likewise, the period during which Caldor can solicit acceptances for the reorganization plan has been extended through October 30, 1997.
Warren Feldberg, chairman and chief executive officer, said the extension will enable Caldor to continue review of its five-year Business Plan with the Creditors', Bank and Equity Committees.

"We are confident this Plan offers the greatest potential to restore the company to long-term profitability and growth," he said. "Ultimately, the business plan will provide the basis for Caldor's plan of reorganization."
